# F01 / F02 foundation interface — candidate concurrence

**Status: bilateral geometry concurrence received; F02 source-policy concurrence with F01 candidate.4 recorded. Final joint qualification remains open.** This source artifact responds on the existing [F01 coordination carrier](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/pull/10630#issuecomment-6596927050). F01 accepted the geometry clarifications below, and the F02 assignment owner has now reviewed candidate.4's ownership/change table and §§4.1–4.3 and concurs with their source/specification policy subject to the explicit qualifications in this record. This is not independent design acceptance, a released foundation or permission to implement.

## Parties, versions and custody

| Item | Exact reference |
| --- | --- |
| Assignment | [Production Design package at `6e1862867193ec6486a22001a0e4fb515da20448`](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/tree/6e1862867193ec6486a22001a0e4fb515da20448/research/design_candidates/production_design_20261102) |
| F01 candidate | [Draft #10645](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/pull/10645), source branch `design/f01-shared-shell-v1-20261103-c4`; `F01-F02-SHELL/1.0.0-candidate.4`, [semantic contract at `8926b16af4e0c3e5310cdb4cf057390ec04d18ff`](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/blob/8926b16af4e0c3e5310cdb4cf057390ec04d18ff/research/design_candidates/production_design_20261102/f01/JOINT_SHELL_SYSTEM_CONTRACT.md), blob `1160f14b108bf0948384f59a249320385a1dfb6c`; same contract blob at inspected PR head `3e334bd3eabf1d6ecc7980845fbd7a813dd023e1` |
| F02 component contract | `F02-SYSTEM/1.0.0-candidate.2`, [immutable system contract at `c6eb32e1212ff22a1e3e6e8fe00b08e94bb31d82`](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/blob/c6eb32e1212ff22a1e3e6e8fe00b08e94bb31d82/research/design_candidates/production_design_20261102/f02/SYSTEM_CONTRACT.md) |
| F02 source/data contract | `F02-SOURCE-DATA/1.0.0-candidate.2`, [source and data contract at the same commit](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/blob/c6eb32e1212ff22a1e3e6e8fe00b08e94bb31d82/research/design_candidates/production_design_20261102/f02/SOURCE_AND_DATA_CONTRACT.md) |
| F02 token reference | [token-map.json at the same commit](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/blob/c6eb32e1212ff22a1e3e6e8fe00b08e94bb31d82/research/design_candidates/production_design_20261102/f02/token-map.json), Git blob `a7ec801d3b559cc64f4fd57141c32f63098c6461`; semantic specimen roles, not a new production CSS namespace |
| F02 design source | [Draft #10630](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/pull/10630), branch `design/f02-system-v1-20261102-c2`; [actual Paper Read me page](https://app.paper.design/file/01M312VSDSZFVT45674GDVJVZN/p-9-0) |

F01 owns global navigation, shell slots, context/search/account behavior and focused/public/internal shell composition. F02 owns shared component anatomy, presentation semantics and their evidence specifications. Domain owners retain data, entitlement, query identity, export and mutation contracts. Each author keeps its own source and Paper targets; this artifact makes no change to F01's branch, boards or the shared return ledger outside F02's row.

The latest F01 source baseline's [shared-shell.css at Terminal `3cc8da8432d8d2d4e4cb597f49c4eaa95f1980c9`](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/mastermind-terminal/blob/3cc8da8432d8d2d4e4cb597f49c4eaa95f1980c9/terminal/components/chrome/shared-shell/shared-shell.css), blob `d40551b54752c7d577b459ddfa2b5da1f4f6cbf9`, was read directly. Its 224/196/72px rail and 64/56px header rules agree with the values already inspected for F02. This is a bounded source comparison, not a claim about the currently deployed revision or every change between the two source baselines.

## Concurrence and precise responsive rules

F01 explicitly accepted F02's cutoffs and transition clarifications in [comment 6598159141](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/pull/10630#issuecomment-6598159141), binding bilateral candidate.2 geometry at [245a7d2cd62d88fb6d2ee3863f9d26c63052d8e7](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/blob/245a7d2cd62d88fb6d2ee3863f9d26c63052d8e7/research/design_candidates/production_design_20261102/f01/JOINT_SHELL_SYSTEM_CONTRACT.md). Candidate.4 retains that geometry and the token-map blob; the [later F01 request](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/pull/10630#issuecomment-6617496947) asks for scoped response to changed behavior, not another geometry choice. Older D02/D08 reports of the 768px gutter boundary and 400px modal remain valid for their candidate.1 inputs; those particular differences are resolved in the current source.

The agreed candidate uses 224/196/72/0px rails, 64/56px headers, 24/20/16px horizontal content gutters, one contextual shared evidence inspector, a 320px dock, a 24px dock gap and at least 640px of primary workspace. The following cutoffs remain source-bound specifications; they are not tested browser behavior.

| Effective CSS viewport width | Expanded navigation | Header | Content gutter on each side |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| At most 600px | No rail | 56px | 16px |
| Greater than 600px and at most 860px | No rail | 56px | 20px |
| Greater than 860px and less than 1200px | 196px | 64px | 20px |
| At least 1200px | 224px | 64px | 24px |

The 600px content-gutter boundary is the existing F02 specimen boundary. It is distinct from the 860px shell-navigation boundary. The inequalities above deliberately cover fractional effective CSS widths such as 600.5, 860.5 and 1199.5px. F01 accepted this continuous clarification in the candidate geometry: the historical source uses literal `min-width:861px` / `max-width:1199px` for its middle class, so its behavior in fractional gaps is not asserted to equal this continuous rule. Header internal padding remains F01's composition responsibility; a content gutter is not automatically a header token. In the desktop shell, an explicitly selected compact rail is 72px. Neither F02 nor a consumer may automatically change the user's navigation preference to make a dock fit.

Let `C` be the **measured usable content width after the actual shell, local reserved chrome and both content gutters**. Dock only when `C − 320 − 24 ≥ 640`; equivalently `C ≥ 984`. Additional reserved local chrome reduces `C`. The width of an enclosing Paper artboard or a device label is not a substitute for this measurement.

| Viewport | Rail | Both gutters | Usable content C | Width if docked | Candidate presentation |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |
| 320 | 0 | 32 | 288 | −56 | Full-width overlay; 288px underlying content when closed |
| 390 | 0 | 32 | 358 | 14 | Full-width overlay; 358px underlying content when closed |
| 768 | 0 | 40 | 728 | 384 | 440px overlay; complete underlying comparison remains available |
| 1024 | 196 | 40 | 788 | 444 | 440px overlay |
| 1280 | 224 | 48 | 1008 | 664 | 320px dock plus 24px gap |
| 1440 | 224 | 48 | 1168 | 824 | 320px dock plus 24px gap |
| 1600 | 224 | 48 | 1328 | 984 | 320px dock plus 24px gap |

These are calculated examples with no additional local reserved chrome. Native width studies supply editable geometric evidence; they do not prove browser reflow. Under this rule, a wide expanded shell first permits a dock at 1256px. The historical HTML specimen's 1280px media breakpoint is conservative supporting history, not the final measured-container rule. In the greater-than-860px / less-than-1200px class, a user-selected 72px rail first permits a dock at 1096px. Do not substitute either inferred viewport threshold for measuring the actual content slot.

At 600px and below, the evidence overlay occupies the full available viewport width and uses internal content padding. At the represented 768/1024px widths it is 440px wide, constrained to the available viewport. It must remain usable at smaller effective widths, browser zoom and increased text size. Evidence content scrolls vertically inside its own surface. A table may retain a deliberate local horizontal scroll region with all fields and an immediately reachable full-row evidence action.

## Interaction, preference and ownership boundary

| Concern | Required behavior and owner |
| --- | --- |
| Inspector identity | Domain-owned entity/row/field/observation identity remains exact. A new evidence selection replaces the existing contextual inspector; it does not stack evidence dialogs or silently write a saved object. |
| Overlay | Named dialog, visible Close action, initial focus, background made inert and contained Tab sequence. The active owner handles Escape/Close. When the retiring surface legitimately owns focus, restore the connected current trigger by stable identity; if its row is gone, use the named comparison heading and explain why. Preserve deliberate later focus elsewhere, plus table sort/filter, selected identity and local scroll. |
| Dock | Nonmodal complementary region; do not trap focus or make the primary comparison inert. Preserve the same evidence identity and an explicit route back to the originating cell or row. Closing returns focus only when this retiring surface legitimately owns it; preserve intentional later focus elsewhere. |
| Responsive mode change | Preserve evidence identity and user context while changing presentation. Reconcile focus/inertness between dock and overlay, moving focus only when the retiring surface owns it and keeping intentional later focus elsewhere. No duplicate mounted inspector or hidden focused control. Browser proof remains required. |
| Other global layers | F01 owns shared-layer policy for search, account, navigation and evidence. The existing Brain/D14 owner retains widget lifecycle, requests and context; the existing host binds that interface. D06 owns focused composition. “One inspector” does not authorize deletion, duplication or unmounting of Brain. Focused `/terminal` retains its incumbent chrome, chart tools, context handoff and return behavior. |
| Theme and market convention | Use semantic roles and the actual scope-specific source aliases. Preserve incumbent preference ownership until a reviewed migration exists. Language and price direction are distinct concepts; health, aggressor side and exposure do not change meaning when the language changes. |
| Public and internal shells | F01 decides the relevant shell. Public editorial keeps public navigation and reading measure; a shared component does not impose the investor rail. Operational/internal views retain their access and domain boundaries. |
| Source and writes | Opening, closing or switching evidence is read-only. Existing producer, entitlement, save request identity and confirmation belong to their current source owners. A design action does not create a new endpoint, storage key or grant. |

## Scoped F02 concurrence with candidate.4

The F02 assignment owner concurs with the ownership/change table and §§4.1–4.3 of the exact candidate.4 contract bound above as **source/specification policy**. The following table records the adopted meaning and its remaining proof boundary; it does not transfer another owner's authority or accept the entire F01 visual set.

| Clause | F02 concurrence | Conditions that remain open |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Ownership and preceding source repairs | F01 owns shell/global navigation, slots and shared-layer policy; F02 owns shared anatomy, formatting and accessibility/motion primitives. Preserve explicit compact choice, correct current-destination labels and full domain table/history scope. | Domain, host, Brain/D14 and D06 ownership remains as stated. Source coherence does not qualify native pixels, every retained field or runtime behavior. |
| §4.1 Shared evidence and Brain | Suspend shared evidence presentation through the qualified existing owner when invoking the singleton Brain; retain the exact evidence identity and return anchor. Release dock width/modal ownership coherently, provide truthful failed-open recovery, and leave evidence reachable but closed until explicit reopen. | The served widget and host must qualify visible lifecycle and callback lifetime. `open()` invocation, a true opener result, `mounted` or readiness does not acknowledge visibility. No invented event, private-DOM poll, queued surprise opening, second assistant or new store. Focused Terminal adoption is separately qualified. |
| §4.1 Focus, Escape and requests | Restore focus only when the retiring surface legitimately owns it; use a connected identity-based trigger or the named logical fallback, and preserve intentional later focus elsewhere. The active owner handles nested Escape. Closing or resizing presentation does not cancel an answer, resolve a save or imply Saved. | The actual `MM_BRAIN_CFG.onClose` is conditional focus restoration, not an all-close event. Brain/D14 and the host retain Stop, continuation and outcome. Rapid transitions, delayed callbacks, nested Escape and focus/inertness require browser proof. |
| §4.2 Focused reader | Preserve the distinct Terminal reader: 360px initial width, requested 300–520px clamp and incumbent `mm.railW`. Temporary effective fitting does not overwrite the preference. Shared 320+24 geometry applies to shared evidence, not this reader. | D06/Terminal/Options qualify actual chart fit, occupied axes/tools/gaps/scrollbar and inline/focused fallback. D06's proposed 640px price plot is a different measured object from the shared 640px primary container. |
| §4.2 Cursor and historical Ask | Crosshair and stepping share one current visual inspection cursor. AI locked selection and Intelligence event selection retain their existing owners. Validate listing/market, interval, selected time/time basis and source/context generation before an exact historical Ask. Revalidate prepared attachments; preserve an already-dispatched request's original object. | Do not invent a committed-versus-hover store, retarget or cancel a sent request on later cursor movement, or substitute current quote/calendar data for missing historical evidence. Actual attachment and served request behavior remain unqualified. |
| §4.3 Listing, search and return | Preserve validated canonical listing plus trimmed `company_query`, the existing `mmxCompanySearch` history marker, preview/explicit commit, safe-origin gates and exact accepted return URL. Generic Terminal entry does not imply a current company; invalid explicit identity cannot fall back to a stale shared company. | D07/Search and Terminal retain parsers and route identity. Accepted URL return, picker-history restoration and complete selection/scroll/focus restoration are separate promises. No new storage key, generic interval/bar parameter or broader trusted origin. |

These distinctions are supported by the directly inspected [Terminal typed Brain bridge](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/mastermind-terminal/blob/3cc8da8432d8d2d4e4cb597f49c4eaa95f1980c9/terminal/lib/mastermindBrain.ts), [current ShellSearch](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/mastermind-terminal/blob/2ded360882b9c721e690907ff363b553781fb920/terminal/components/chrome/shared-shell/ShellSearch.tsx), [company search context](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/mastermind-terminal/blob/2ded360882b9c721e690907ff363b553781fb920/terminal/lib/companySearchContext.ts), [origin navigation](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/mastermind-terminal/blob/3cc8da8432d8d2d4e4cb597f49c4eaa95f1980c9/terminal/lib/originNav.ts) and the attributed [D06 handshake at d7d6b7d](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/blob/d7d6b7ddcd950d7e9879bbf58c7e2e481b4708bf/research/design_candidates/production_design_20261102/d06/BRAIN_SHELL_HANDSHAKE.md). F02 has not reproduced D06's live observations or attested the served Brain asset. The [dependency review](paper/reviews/f01-continuation-dependency-review-20261103.json) preserves exact input blobs and the earlier recommendation; this owner response consumes that advice without rewriting its history.

Actual non-author [source-only review 5760649569](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/pull/10645#pullrequestreview-5760649569) applies to F01 head `3e334bd3eabf1d6ecc7980845fbd7a813dd023e1` and candidate.4's unchanged semantic blob. It supersedes neither the scope of earlier review 5760292764 at `be157007` nor any native, RIG, QA01 or release gate. The F02 response here is cross-owner concurrence, not an independent review receipt.

## Stable component and token consumption

The component vocabulary contains 21 roles. `SectionHeader`, `MetricValue`, `ChangeValue`, `FreshnessReceipt`, `DataRow`, `TableFrame`, `ChartFrame`, `Tabs`, `EvidenceTrigger`, `EvidenceInspector`, `StatePanel`, `Callout`, `DetailDisclosure`, `Action`, `SaveFeedback`, `TierGate` and `Icon` provide the portable shared anatomy. `VirtualizedDataInspector`, `CountLadder`, `LifecycleRail` and `DecisionRow / VerdictHero` retain domain-specific source semantics and are not globally qualified replacements.

These are design-contract names. The [source contract](SOURCE_AND_DATA_CONTRACT.md) maps them to actual Macro, Terminal and public estate owners. Do not invent corresponding imports or install a new foundation package merely because a role has a name. The [current native authority note](paper/CURRENT_DESIGN_AUTHORITY.md) identifies the latest export/capture and repair precedence. Participation fixture v3 changes synthetic records and does not rename the component contract.

The 20 original Paper color tokens remain an observed dark palette. The token map also identifies proposed light values and source-scope collisions, including `--sp-8`, `panel2` versus `panel-2`, financial figures versus code typography, and focused-chart versus shared-shell theme scopes. F01 may consume the semantic reference now for candidate composition; it must not globally alias tokens by spelling or overwrite focused-chart semantics.

## F01-facing defects and qualification conditions

No conflicting rail/header value was found in this bounded source check. The remaining material width/state risks are explicit:

1. Docking by a fixed viewport label instead of usable content can shrink the primary comparison below 640px when local chrome is present. Use the measured rule above and test actual expanded and selected-compact states.
2. A shell breakpoint, content-gutter breakpoint and dock decision are different decisions. The exhaustive 600/860/1200 cutoffs are agreed in source; verify both sides and fractional values, including effective narrow width at 400% zoom. Historical integer media-query gaps must not be carried into the continuous candidate contract.
3. Overlay-to-dock transitions and global layer arbitration need real focus/inertness proof. Native screenshots and adjacent instructions do not execute those behaviors.
4. The first native product and taste reviews found numeric alignment, fixture coherence, annual comparison visibility and missing width/state evidence. Repairs and final independent repaired-set review are in progress. No prior BLOCK finding is closed merely by this concurrence.
5. Joint freeze still requires the final slot/navigation/preference and lifecycle bindings, F02's exact final native artifact identity, affected consumer qualification and actual independent review evidence. Bilateral geometry and this scoped F02 candidate.4 policy concurrence do not complete those obligations. Formal RIG remains draft and needs actual admitted reviewer-class evidence and the designated authority verdict.

The next joint record should cite the two immutable source commits, precise versions, used roles, actual Paper targets, reviewed theme/locale/width/state coverage, any retained domain variant and all carried conditions. This concurrence may be used as a concrete input to that record. It is not a substitute for it.

# Interaction, state and accessibility contract

Companion to `F02-SYSTEM/1.0.0-candidate.2`, with the source-policy refinements bound by [F02 concurrence with F01 candidate.4](F01_HANDSHAKE_CANDIDATE.md). This is a proposed component contract, not a new domain API. See [SOURCE_AND_DATA_CONTRACT.md](SOURCE_AND_DATA_CONTRACT.md) for actual owners and current behavior. The HTML specimen demonstrates local state transitions in source; browser execution is unverified. No production save, preference, export or entitlement was exercised or changed during this assignment.

## Independent state axes

| Axis | Vocabulary | What must remain separate |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Availability | loading, loaded, empty-with-reason, unavailable, unsupported, error | A completed zero-result query versus a publisher that never supplied data |
| Coverage | complete, partial, unknown | Available count, eligible population and missing count; no invented denominator |
| Freshness | current by owner policy, stale, unknown | Source observation, publication, retrieval and successful network response |
| Transport | connecting, connected, reconnecting, failed | The age/completeness of the data carried by the connection |
| Market session | open, closed, holiday, unknown | Connection state and source update state |
| Access | guest, allowed, denied/plan-required, expired, service-unavailable | Resource denial versus entitlement provider failure; never use a client color as enforcement |
| Interaction | default, hover, selected, focused, disabled, busy | Selection can persist after focus moves; keyboard focus must remain visible |
| Mutation | idle/draft, pending, saved, failed, uncertain | Network ambiguity is not confirmed failure; saved requires actual owner confirmation/readback |
| Provenance | reported, derived, estimated, illustrative, model output | A source citation does not validate a model or turn a heuristic into probability |

Combination rule: keep usable values when their source identity still matches the current context, show the original clock and a concise affected-scope caveat, and prevent incompatible actions. If the entity/listing/context changes, do not relabel retained data from the previous entity. Use the existing request-generation/race guard. One compact receipt can express several axes, for example “Connected · Market closed · Source 30 Oct · Partial 7/8”; it is not four decorative status cards.

## Copy and recovery matrix

Copy below is final proposed component copy with placeholders to be supplied by the actual owner. The specimen supplies illustrative availability, freshness, coverage, access and write axes. Its local simulations do not demonstrate every consumer recovery route or producer state. Public static articles do not manufacture account/save or live-transport states; they reuse relevant source/error patterns only where such behavior actually exists.

| State | English | Simplified Chinese | Retained content / recovery |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Loading | **Loading observations.** Values will appear when the source responds. No result count is available yet. | **正在加载观测数据。** 来源响应后将显示数值。当前尚无结果数量。 | Keep stable layout and any valid earlier snapshot clearly dated. `aria-busy=true`; skeleton decorative; no “empty” label. |
| Loaded | **Source: {observation}.** {coverage}. | **来源：{观测时间}。** {覆盖范围}。 | Values, units and evidence reachable. No permanent success banner for routine fetches. |
| Empty query | **No observations match this view.** The request completed with 0 matching records. | **没有符合此视图的观测数据。** 请求已完成，匹配记录为0。 | Show current filters and clear/reset action. Do not imply no market activity. |
| No publication yet | **No observation has been published for {period}.** | **{期间}尚未发布观测数据。** | Keep calendar/source context. No “0” until the producer reports zero. |
| Partial | **Partial coverage.** {available} of {eligible} observations are available. Missing values are not zero. | **覆盖不完整。** {eligible}次观测中{available}次可用。缺失值不等于零。 | Preserve available chart/table; explicit gaps. If denominator unknown, say “Coverage not quantified” rather than a fraction. |
| Stale | **Older observations retained.** Source: {time}. The expected update has not arrived. | **保留较早观测。** 来源：{时间}。预期更新尚未到达。 | Source policy supplies expected cadence; retain exact period and source, no “live” label. |
| Unknown freshness | **Source age unavailable.** A source observation time was not supplied. | **无法确定来源时效。** 未提供来源观测时间。 | Retrieval time can be shown separately; it cannot substitute for source time. |
| Unsupported | **This source is not supported for this listing.** No value has been inferred. | **此挂牌标识尚不支持该来源。** 未推断任何数值。 | Existing owner/coverage explanation, alternative valid sources, return to supported context. |
| Source unavailable | **This source is unavailable.** Other available evidence remains visible. | **此来源不可用。** 仍显示其他可用证据。 | Retry only if actual owner supports it; no fake refresh control on a static document. |
| Refresh error | **Refresh failed.** The last successful view is still available. | **刷新失败。** 仍可查看上次成功加载的数据。 | Retry read; keep error context and prior clock. Do not clear useful data or mutate a saved view. |
| Guest | **Sign in to save this view.** Public evidence remains available. | **登录后可保存视图。** 仍可查看公开证据。 | Only when the actual route allows public reading. Preserve existing return URL through the existing sign-in flow. |
| Plan required | **This source requires an eligible plan.** Available public data remains visible. | **此来源需要符合条件的订阅。** 仍显示可用公开数据。 | Server omits restricted payload. Existing plan entry only; no fabricated plan names or prices. |
| Expired before send | **Your session expired.** Your view is retained. Sign in again before saving; no change has been sent. | **会话已过期。** 已保留当前视图。再次登录后方可保存；尚未发送更改。 | Applicable only with proof request was not sent. Preserve draft/context and exact authorized return target. |
| Expired after send | **Your session expired while saving.** The outcome is unknown. Check the existing request after signing in. | **保存期间会话已过期。** 结果未知。登录后请检查现有请求。 | Do not label failed or resend without readback/deduplication evidence. |
| First use | **Choose a starting view.** Open an example or select an available instrument. | **选择起始视图。** 打开示例或选择可用标的。 | Show real valid choices supplied by domain owner; no arbitrary unsupported default. |
| Pending save | **Saving…** This request is pending. | **正在保存…** 请求待处理。 | Disable repeat submission. Persist request identity when the real owner supports it; do not block unrelated reading. |
| Saved | **Saved.** {object} is confirmed. | **已保存。** 已确认{对象}。 | Only after owner's successful result/readback. Offer existing open/return action, not a fabricated new object. |
| Failed save | **Save failed.** Your last saved view is unchanged. Retry when ready. | **保存失败。** 上次保存的视图未改变。可准备好后重试。 | Only for a confirmed noncommit/failure. Retain local draft. If prior state cannot be established, use uncertain. |
| Uncertain save | **Save outcome unknown.** Check the existing request before retrying. | **保存结果未知。** 重试前请检查现有请求。 | Primary action “Check request status / 检查请求状态”; keep request/object identity; prevent blind duplicate writes. |
| Corrected source | **The source revised this observation.** View the correction and prior value. | **来源修订了此观测值。** 查看修订内容及先前数值。 | Preserve revision lineage and as-of semantics from actual producer; do not fabricate a historical version. |

## Control/action contracts

| Control | Preconditions and resulting state | URL, writes and ownership | Keyboard / touch / focus / scroll |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Local tab | Visible enabled tab; select corresponding panel; retain filters/selection per domain contract | Use existing domain parser if tab is URL-addressable; otherwise local UI only. Never reuse specimen query keys as production route grammar. | Tab enters selected tab. Arrow keys/Home/End move roving focus. Manual Enter/Space activates. Selected fill is neutral; focus outline distinct. Active panel has an accessible label. |
| Sort | Loaded rows and declared sortable field; comparator uses raw values, stable secondary identity and explicit absence placement | Existing view-state owner; no backend mutation. Server-sort routes retain existing pagination/cursors. | Button in a scoped column header; `aria-sort` on that header. Announce resulting order. Keep focus on the header button, not page top. |
| Filter | Apply valid domain filter; show filter summary and count/scope | Preserve existing query parsing and invalid states; no implicit saved-screen write. Option tape's complete filter set remains D08-owned. | Enter or explicit Apply, clear action and label. Updating rows does not steal focus. No-results gives recovery action. |
| Row evidence | Stable row/field/source identity; open one inspector for that exact observation | No new route unless existing owner supports addressable evidence; no write. Preserve return route/hash/scroll. | Each trigger names its row. Wide dock does not trap; narrow modal traps focus and makes background inert. The active owner handles Close/Escape. If the retiring surface owns focus, restore the connected current trigger by identity; if removed, use the named table heading and announce why. Preserve deliberate later focus elsewhere. |
| Chart values | Same dataset/version as plotted marks; expose exact period/value/unit/absence | Existing data inspector where available; ordinary native table otherwise. No duplicate independently fetched series. | Keyboard-accessible action moves focus to the values panel/tab. Touch requires no hover. Exact-value path exposes missing points too. |
| Horizontal table region | Required 2D comparison exceeds usable width | Local scroll only; avoid whole document width inflation. Preserve active row/column on inspector return. | Named region with focusable scroll container. Sticky identity column and visible scroll hint; complete-row evidence reachable without dragging to the final column. |
| Virtualized list/grid | Existing domain-specific inspector and canonical item/time keys | Preserve replay identity, selected record set, sort, CSV scope and paging. F02 does not implement a second virtualizer. | Existing Arrow/Page/Home/End/Shift/Space/Enter/Escape semantics retained. Mounted active descendant, row count/index, correct focus after recycling and screen-reader verification required. |
| Disclosure | Optional details only; expanded content belongs to the current context | No hidden mutation on expansion. Preserve source request/cache semantics if existing lazy read. | Native details/summary or equivalent accessible pattern. Enter/Space; no essential hover; expanded state announced. |
| Refresh | Real refresh callback exists; request new observation under same entity | Read only. Preserve source clocks and request generations; no global TTL added by F02. | Explicit busy state, recoverable error, no focus jump. Announce completion politely without live-region flooding. |
| Save | User identity/entitlement and real write owner valid; explicit click | D23/current owner controls payload, dedupe, request identity, commit and readback. ## Focus, overlays and input details

The shared inspector replaces the previous shared inspector. It does not stack multiple modal contexts. A modal uses an accessible dialog name, initial focus on the close control or contextual heading, contained Tab/Shift+Tab cycling, active-owner Escape, background inertness and preserved background scroll. If the viewport crosses the dock/overlay threshold while open, retain the exact evidence identity and return target; do not silently close, change rows or reset the table. Reconcile focus/inertness once through the existing owner. Move or restore focus only when the retiring surface legitimately owns it; preserve intentional later focus elsewhere. Nested Brain/chart Escape priorities must not also retire an outer layer or activate a background shortcut.

The docked inspector is a complementary region. It may receive focus after explicit opening but must not trap users. When the closing dock legitimately owns focus, return to the still-connected current trigger by stable identity, never a different row at the old positional index. If that row is absent, focus the named table/section heading and announce why. If the user intentionally moved focus elsewhere, preserve that later focus instead of stealing it back. Preserve the table state and context without automatically scrolling a different active task. Candidate 2 captures the stable evidence key, source record and table scroll context; its historical prototype resolves a visible trigger by key after a sort/filter rerender. That prototype is not proof of the refined conditional-ownership behavior. Connected-node return, removal fallback, retained scroll and no-focus-theft transitions still need real browser/assistive-technology testing.

### Shared evidence, Brain and the focused reader

F01 owns shared-layer policy; F02 supplies the applicable anatomy and accessibility primitives. The existing Brain/D14 and host owners retain widget lifecycle, requests and exact context. For the proposed shared policy, suspend evidence presentation coherently when invoking the existing singleton, retain its evidence/return identity, and provide truthful recovery if opening fails. Evidence remains reachable but closed until the user explicitly reopens it; revalidate entity/field/period, source generation and access before showing it again. No forced reopen, queued surprise modal or new coordinator is introduced. `open()` invocation, a true opener result, readiness and mounted state are not visibility acknowledgments. Conditional `MM_BRAIN_CFG.onClose` is a focus-return hook, not an all-close event. Hiding or resizing a panel is distinct from Stop, cancellation, rollback and save confirmation. These owner-bound transitions remain specified, not executed.

Focused `/terminal` keeps its separate reader and chrome. The source reader starts at 360px, accepts a requested 300–520px width through incumbent `mm.railW`, and adapts effective fitting without overwriting that request. It does not inherit the shared 320+24 inspector geometry. D06/Terminal/Options qualify plot-specific minimums and inline/focused fallback; the proposed 640px price plot is not the shared 640px primary-container measurement.

The shared inspector's captured evidence record must not create a committed-versus-hover pin in the focused reader. Crosshair and stepping share one visual inspection cursor; AI locked selection and Intelligence event selection retain their existing owners. Presentation-only changes preserve the current valid reader context. Exact historical Ask must validate listing/market, interval, time/time basis and source/context generation before dispatch. A prepared attachment revalidates when that context changes; a dispatched request keeps its original object identity despite later cursor movement. Missing historical evidence remains unavailable. Exact accepted return URLs, picker-history restoration and complete selection/scroll/focus restoration remain separate qualifications under the [versioned F01/F02 concurrence](F01_HANDSHAKE_CANDIDATE.md).

At 400% zoom from 1280px, the target is a usable 320 CSS-pixel page. Body copy, headings, errors, actions and inspector controls must reflow. Necessary chart/table 2D interaction stays inside that component. A smaller screenshot is not proof of zoom, keyboard operation or target size.

The 44px programme target applies to important phone controls. Dense desktop controls may be smaller while meeting the applicable WCAG 2.2 target-size rule and spacing. Do not call 44px the AA minimum. Touch equivalence includes long-label disclosure and evidence access without a hover prerequisite.

Reduced-motion treatment is a meaningful static state. Do not animate numeric transitions in a way that manufactures intermediate prices. Do not auto-scroll a table or use motion as the sole update cue. Forced-color mode retains labels, outlines and shapes; semantic meaning survives loss of custom hue.

## Candidate 2 model and integration boundary

The supporting reference has separate `availability`, `freshness`, `coverage`, `access` and `write` fields. `SAVE_START`, `SAVE_RESULT` and `SAVE_CHECK` only change the write axis. An access change after pending changes the write outcome to uncertain. A read retry changes availability only; it cannot assert a newer source clock or repaired coverage without a corresponding read result. The fixture's “Response complete” harness setting refers to delivery of its declared example records, not a guarantee that every optional field is known; individual missing/unsupported fields keep their labels.

The combined case is available through `?consumer=macro&availability=loaded&freshness=stale&coverage=partial&access=member&write=pending`. Saving from a loaded, stale, partial state retains both read notices after the local success simulation. Loading, empty and unsupported availability also remain unchanged by save transitions. No account service is called.

The source model was checked across 480 state combinations and 3,360 write/access transitions. These checks establish read-state invariance for the enumerated pure transitions; they do not establish DOM behavior, focus, real service authority, or end-to-end preservation.

Access recovery remains a host integration requirement. The reference does not invent a sign-in or plan URL for its fictional EXM entity. F01/D25 and each route owner must bind actual return URLs and access destinations; D23 must bind real request identity, confirmation and reconciliation. The decorative shell context carries no fabricated entity-navigation link. Full Company statement/period/transcript controls, Options share/export/saved-screen flows, Macro regime/risk/calendar paths and the existing virtualized inspector remain open qualification cases, not passing paths inferred from painted controls.

The public article's retained English content has `lang="en"`; shared bilingual chrome and component demonstrations retain their own language. A translated article route is not created.
